purpose: Teach: 変態/下痢/淘汰/封鎖/犯す/駆除/悟り/生ずる

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の変態行為を警察、捜査中ですね
lines.en: So with this case, the police are investigating the suspect's perverted behavior, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely curious. Leans forward slightly. Soft attack on the opening phrase. Pauses between clauses—he's assembling the question as he speaks, not reciting it. Warm but tentative.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、食中毒による下痢被害を確認しております
lines.en: We've confirmed cases of food poisoning and gastrointestinal illness among the affected individuals.
lines.style: Clear, measured official tone. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. No rush. Steady breath control. Eyes level. The professionalism of someone who has said difficult things many times before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、過去の犯罪組織の淘汰を警察、進められたんですね
lines.en: And with this case, the police were able to dismantle that old criminal organization, weren't they?
lines.style: Respectful, almost admiring. Slightly slower pace. The tone of someone piecing together a larger story. Gentle interrogative lilt at the end—seeking confirmation, not correction.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、道路封鎖を実施しております
lines.en: We've implemented road closures in the affected area.
lines.style: Factual, unhurried. Flat affect without coldness. Precise word choice. The voice of operational necessity—informative, not defensive. Slight pause before the main action word.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害を犯す加害者を警察、特定中ですね
lines.en: So in this case, the police are currently identifying the perpetrator responsible for the harm, correct?
lines.style: Engaged, methodical. Slightly higher pitch on the core question. Careful phrasing—he's trying to get the details right. Genuine, not performative. A beat of patience at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、害虫駆除業者の協力も得ております
lines.en: We're also receiving cooperation from pest control services.
lines.style: Calm, collaborative tone. Matter-of-fact delivery. No drama. The voice of someone listing necessary steps. Slight warmth on the word 'cooperation'—acknowledging the help without overstating it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の悟りに警察、感動されたんですね
lines.en: And the police were moved by how the victim responded to all of this with such grace, weren't they?
lines.style: Gentle, almost reverent. Slower pace, softer attack. A note of wonder underneath—he's expressing something he genuinely finds meaningful. Trailing-off at the very end, like he's still processing it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場から生ずる悲しみに寄り添います
lines.en: We stand with those affected by the grief arising from this situation.
lines.style: Quiet, sincere compassion. Slower, deliberate pacing. Weight behind each phrase. The formality here is genuine, not stiff. Soft voice. A man speaking from careful, hard-won understanding.
